Q0611

“I observe that it does exist, by the same right and in…” — Paulin Hountondji ("African Philosophy, Myth and Reality")

Verified English quotation. Primary source: "African Philosophy, Myth and Reality". Theme: philosophy.

Quotes / Paulin Hountondji / Q0611

English

I observe that it does exist, by the same right and in the same mode as all the philosophies of the world: in the form of a literature.
Thinker Paulin Hountondji
School Africana Philosophy
Source "African Philosophy, Myth and Reality"
Theme Philosophy

Source context

Archive record: this English passage is associated with "African Philosophy, Myth and Reality", within the Africana Philosophy tradition. Use the cited work or edition when a scholarly attribution is needed.

A short reading

Read in the register of philosophy, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Paulin Hountondji's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
